t: A tiny Silicon Labs chip built for Matter, Thread, Zigbee and Bluetooth gadgets.
steps: Buy a Seeed XIAO MG24 or an Arduino Nano Matter from a maker shop.
Get a USB-C cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the Silicon Labs board package in the board manager.
Run the Burn bootloader step one time before your first upload.
Upload the Blink example and watch the light.
Try a Bluetooth example and find the board with a phone app.
meta: Open Board. From $7.90. A few stores.
